ops.text: On a Sprite Orca lane, each drive verb relays through a blocking orca orchestration ask that waited 40 to 70 minutes for the coordinator's Mac to answer (job j3771, Nov 15 2026: drive pr add, drive job set --repro and drive status). A Bash call stopped at its limit leaves the question pending on the coordinator, so the lane cannot tell whether a verb took and has to read it back later with drive status or the orca inbox before retyping. A write verb should hand back an id at once and answer through the inbox, or the shim should say the verb is queued and safe to stop.
